# Anthony Tulk

## Overview

- **Age:** School-aged boy  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has dark eyes.

_Sources: [v1 c27 P6](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0006), [v1 c27 P15](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0015)_

## Personality

Anthony is a cheeky, independent, and stubborn boy with a sullen, insolent demeanor. He possesses a strong sense of pride and a disdain for female teachers, whom he initially considers useless. Despite his defiant and aloof exterior, he respects physical strength, discipline, and authenticity, and can be won over by someone who stands up to him or shows genuine kindness without being patronizing.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c27 P4](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0004), [v1 c27 P8](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0008), [v1 c27 P40](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0040)_

## History

Anthony Tulk attended the local school in Brierley. After Nell Harcourt began teaching, he showed continuous disdain and disrespect toward her due to his belief that female teachers were useless. He regularly tested her patience, glaring at her with insolence and mocking her behind her back. One day, after placing a live mouse inside Nell's desk to startle her, he openly admitted his responsibility with an impudent laugh. Pushed past her limit, Nell lost her temper and whipped him with a hardwood pointer. Although Nell felt deep shame and regret for losing her self-control, the punishment earned Anthony's respect. The next morning, Anthony greeted her politely, offered to carry her books, and admitted to his peers that she was capable of delivering a beating 'as good as a man's.' From that point on, he stopped giving her trouble, worked hard in class, and developed a genuine fondness and respect for her.

_Sources: [v1 c27 P4](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0004), [v1 c27 P8](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0008), [v1 c27 P13](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0013), [v1 c27 P14](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0014), [v1 c27 P22](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0022), [v1 c27 P29](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0029), [v1 c27 P36](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0036), [v1 c27 P40](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0040)_
